novelty_flags.one_line: The proposal calls its mean-zero-error family the exact Appendix A.1 Gu family, but Gu et al.'s displayed (A.1) imposes E[εY|X,T]=0; the proposed E[ε|X,T]=0 family is therefore not the cited experiment, so the claimed strict tightening of its m_Gu is unsupported.

source_verification_receipts.locator: p. 18, Appendix A.1, equations (A.1)–(A.2), lines 1975–2015; p. 19, Theorem A.1, lines 2016–2081
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: (A.1) defines P(F_mu,F_pi) with the displayed condition E[εY|X,T]=0, while (A.2) takes suprema over F_mu,F_pi followed by an infimum over class-tailored estimators; Theorem A.1 gives the stated upper minimum and lower expression.
The note states that black-box PLM DML optimality remains open and identifies variance as the unresolved distinction from structure-aware settings.

source_verification_receipts.version: NeurIPS 2025 paper: proceedings text access-gated; public author manuscript arXiv:2507.02275 inspected
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorem 3.1 gives a binary-treatment supplied-nuisance quantile-risk lower bound, and Theorem 3.2 gives a Gaussian-treatment barrier with a product term and logarithmic factor; neither is Gu's fixed-class expected-absolute-risk experiment.
The PLM-specific instantiation concerns expected conditional covariance under binary treatment and proves an anchored-neighborhood mixed-bias lower bound, not the Gu coefficient fixed-class frontier.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Make the comparator exact: either use Gu's displayed E[εY|X,T]=0 condition throughout and re-establish the non-atomic fuzzy construction, or obtain a source correction before asserting a tightening of Theorem A.1.

If retaining E[ε|X,T]=0, rename the model as a new mean-zero PLM experiment, remove the claim that it is Gu's exact risk, and prove an explicit inclusion or risk comparison that reconnects it to Gu's frontier.
Add a short construction lemma showing that the selected fixed admissible classes contain a bounded non-atomic treatment hard family under the chosen Appendix-A.1 error condition.

recommended_next_step: Revise the Appendix-A.1 comparator/model mismatch, then rerun novelty review with the corrected exact experiment or a proved comparison between the new mean-zero experiment and Gu's risk.
